description: The `import`s of a test file Jest runs as an ES module (`extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts']`, Node with `--experimental-vm-modules`, no CommonJS transform) and of its helper, in the node environment, from a package whose `exports` list `module-sync` first: jest-runtime's ESM conditions (`import`, `module-sync`, `default` and the environment's `node`, `node-addons`) take the `module-sync` entry. The package `dual` then has a `node` branch (an `import` and a `require` entry), `import`, `require` and `default`; each entry's value names it, and each test's title is the entry it got.
